title: Largest number
promptMd: The first line is `n` (≥ 1). The second line holds `n` integers. Print the largest one. Find it with your own loop — no built-in max or sort.
starterCode: # Read input with input(), print output with print().

forbiddenPatterns.message: Find the largest value with your own loop instead of max/sort.

hints: Keep track of the biggest value you've seen so far.
What should 'biggest so far' start as? Starting at 0 breaks when every number is negative.
Start with the first element, then compare every other element with it.
conceptNoteMd:
A list holds many values in order; index from 0.

```python
nums = [int(x) for x in input().split()]
print(nums[0], len(nums))
for x in nums:
    print(x)
```
